game_title: Return Or Print – Frosted Chapel Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the court_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the sleigh using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the sleigh is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Or Print' (Week 6 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Frosted Chapel'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sleigh reached with actions_used <= 11.
